landing.title: Video, audio and images, converted in one go
landing.desc: Drop your files, pick a format, and Morphex converts, compresses and trims them. Files are deleted right after download — nothing is kept.

video.title: Video / Audio
video.desc: Convert to MP4, WebM, MP3 and more, with control over resolution, frame rate, bitrate and trim range.

image.title: Image
image.desc: Convert or compress images, with scaling, quality, flipping and metadata removal.

batch.title: Batch queue
batch.desc: Add many files at once, then convert all and download all.

tuning.title: Advanced options
tuning.desc: Codecs, CRF, target size, loudness normalization and more.

presets.title: Device presets
presets.desc: One-click settings for iPhone, YouTube, Discord and others.

privacy.title: Deleted after use
privacy.desc: Deleted as soon as you download; undownloaded files are cleared after 30 minutes.

desc.video: Drop a video or audio file, pick a target format, and convert it right in your browser.
desc.image: Drop an image file and pick a target format to convert it.
